# Exeris Bench Routing Planner

## Use When
- Task classification is known and execution ownership must be defined.
- Work requires multiple benchmark specialists.

## Procedure
1. Choose one primary agent by highest risk.
2. Define secondary handoffs only where dependency exists.
3. Produce ordered execution steps with stop/verify points.
4. Attach required metadata capture list.
5. Attach reporting constraints based on comparison axis.

## Required Output
- Primary agent
- Secondary handoffs
- Execution plan
- Required metadata capture
- Reporting constraints
